digest.component_or_area: reconciler JIRA adapter / config ownership gate
propositions: Twelve below-seam ambient config reads in the reconciler JIRA adapter surface are recorded as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows and must be migrated to owned resolvers or marked with read-via markers.

Eleven composed-config reads (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_PROJECT, acli timeout, comment max chars, datacenter settings, pandoc timeout, cutover clients) must be cut-to-seam and delegated through owned config.py resolvers to enforce composition-root ownership.
One debug-switch read (REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in outbound_fields.py) must be owned-in-place with a single # read-via: marker and the unused _rebar_env shim deleted.
Secret credential reads (JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_PAT) remain unchanged as owner=credential and must stay in-boundary.

JIRA endpoint and reconciler config resolvers must preserve live-per-call env-over-file precedence, fail-loud for insecure URLs and malformed config, timeout clamping, and ImportError->default degrade behavior in subprocess contexts.
All 12 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed and the held-out oracle test must pass with zero marker violations and marker total equal to exactly one.
